The channel's thumbnails kept pulling clicks inside YouTube's normal band, and its advertisers paid more per playback. What fell
was the share of views that earned anything. The creator blames YouTube Kids views, which carry no personalised ads. On the
right, disclosed RPM runs from 0.23 to 0.51 of CPM against a ceiling of 0.55: the share of the ad price that becomes pay varies
Source: creators' own disclosures, one row each in data/<year>/creators.csv with its link. The CTR band is from YouTube Help
(data/macro/macro.csv). RPM here is YouTube Studio RPM, per 1,000 views of any kind.
